nodes.label: Requirements for Listing
nodes.summary: Qualitative and quantitative eligibility requirements for Main Board and GEM listing under the HK Listing Rules.

nodes.label: Main Board Eligibility Requirements
nodes.summary: An applicant must satisfy the Exchange that it is suitable for listing and meets the financial, management, and ownership requirements under MBL Rules Chapter 8.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 8.04 — General Conditions
nodes.summary: An applicant must be duly incorporated and must be a going concern.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 8.05 — Financial Tests
nodes.summary: Three financial eligibility tests: profit test, market cap/revenue test, and market cap/revenue/cash flow test.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 8.06 — Management Continuity
nodes.summary: At least 3 consecutive financial years of management continuity under the profit test.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 8.07 — Ownership Continuity
nodes.summary: At least 3 consecutive financial years of ownership continuity under the profit test.

nodes.label: Profit Test (MBL 8.05(1))
nodes.summary: Profit attributable to shareholders of at least HK$50 million in the most recent 3 financial years (HK$20m in most recent year, HK$20m in two preceding years).

nodes.label: MBL Rule 8.05A — Market Cap / Revenue Test
nodes.summary: Market cap of at least HK$4 billion and revenue of at least HK$500 million in the most recent financial year.

nodes.label: Suitability for Listing
nodes.summary: The Exchange must be satisfied that the applicant and its business are suitable for listing, considering fitness and propriety of directors, regulatory compliance, and business model.

nodes.label: HKEX Guidance Letter GL68-13A — Suitability for Listing
nodes.summary: Guidance on factors the Exchange considers when assessing suitability, including regulatory non-compliance, business model viability, and director integrity.

nodes.label: HKEX Listing Decision LD-2018-01 — Suitability Assessment
nodes.summary: Listing Committee considered whether past regulatory breaches rendered an applicant unsuitable; held that candour and remediation are relevant factors.

nodes.label: GEM Eligibility Requirements
nodes.summary: GEM listing requirements are less onerous: a cash flow test of at least HK$30 million for the 2 preceding financial years, with management and ownership continuity of 2 financial years.

nodes.label: GEM Rule 11.06 — General Conditions
nodes.summary: A GEM applicant must be duly incorporated as a going concern.

nodes.label: GEM Rule 11.10 — Cash Flow Test
nodes.summary: Net cash flow from operating activities of at least HK$30 million for the 2 preceding financial years.

nodes.label: GEM Rule 11.12 — Management and Ownership Continuity
nodes.summary: At least 2 consecutive financial years of management and ownership continuity.

nodes.label: SFO Schedule 1, Part 1 — Definitions
nodes.summary: Defines 'listing rules' and 'recognised exchange company' for the purposes of the Securities and Futures Ordinance.

nodes.label: Listing Document Requirements
nodes.summary: The listing document (prospectus) must contain all information necessary for investors to make an informed assessment of the applicant's business and prospects.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 11.07 — Listing Document Contents
nodes.summary: A listing document must contain particulars and information necessary for a reasonable investor to form a valid and comprehensive opinion of the applicant.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 11.11 — Responsibility Statements
nodes.summary: Each director must accept responsibility for the accuracy of the listing document.

nodes.label: Companies (WUMP) Ordinance s.38D — Prospectus Liability
nodes.summary: Civil liability for misstatements in prospectuses; persons responsible include the issuer, directors, promoters, and experts.

nodes.label: Eligibility Assessment Flow
nodes.summary: Step 1: Assess eligibility — determine which financial test applies and verify qualitative requirements.

nodes.label: Suitability and Document Preparation
nodes.summary: Step 2: Prepare listing document, verify suitability, and engage sponsors.
